pins.name: VH
pins.notes: Printer power 5 to 9 V, 2 A: its own supply, never from the ESP32

pins.name: RX
pins.notes: The printer receives here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin

pins.name: TX
pins.notes: Printer status, optional. May be 5 V: use a divider

sources.title: Adafruit Mini Thermal Receipt Printer guide
sources.section: TTL serial at 19200 or 9600 baud (printed on the test page); 5 to 9 V, 2 A supply
